behaviors.description: Load independently authored Blender VR and AR meshes at metric scale; render placed or held pairs in the shared depth scene. Hide worn hardware from first-person view, retaining passthrough. Current runtime uses diffuse facet shading; full glass/metal materials remain in Blender and GLB. No per-frame optical work is introduced.
behaviors.selection: New Mirror VR and AR eyewear; both provide passthrough and identical DAW entry.

checks.expectation: Load independently authored Blender VR and AR meshes at metric scale; render placed or held pairs in the shared depth scene. Hide worn hardware from first-person view, retaining passthrough. Current runtime uses diffuse facet shading; full glass/metal materials remain in Blender and GLB. No per-frame optical work is introduced.
checks.procedure: Inspect Blender review and runtime exports; run focused glasses regressions. Manually check both pairs in the theatre: F pickup/place with obstruction and range, B wear/remove, E opens the existing embedded DAW, exit returns to the retained world. Check held tool suspension, phone arbitration, pause, held-key edges and cleanup. Native interaction remains unverified until actually exercised.
